name: sentineluni-frontend
description: Frontend de SentinelUNI: shell (host) + microfrontends con Webpack 5 Module Federation

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shell,incidents,notifications,audit -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev -w shell" "npm run dev -w mfe-incidents" "npm run dev -w mfe-notifications" "npm run dev -w mfe-audit"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shell --noEmit && tsc -p mfe-incidents --noEmit && tsc -p mfe-notifications --noEmit && tsc -p mfe-audit --noEmit
